decision.observation: 6:50 am Thu 4; the farmer still stands amid the weeds south of the farmhouse facing down; the A tap only advanced time. Open sand lanes lie to the north-east toward the tree and the day-2 exit route.
decision.hypothesis: Rather than clearing the bush wall west, heading north-east around the debris to the yard's east side (chest/sand path) rejoins the day-2 route to the pasture gate, the road, and town.
decision.memory: Day-2/3 successful exit: yard east side by wooden chest → sand path north → gap by signpost → road corridor → east → town plaza. Introductions 7/28; 405g.
